subject: Grouped: Inference Showcase — pick 2 preferred slots (multi-prospect)
body:
Message 1
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jones <sara.jones@acme.com>, ops@stratoworks.com, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@bytefield.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Subject: Grouped: Inference Showcase — pick 2 preferred slots (multi-prospect)

Hi all —

Thanks for your interest in a joint walkthrough of Redwood Inference focused on running inference at scale. To make this valuable for everyone, we plan a single 60-minute group session covering:
- short intro and customer stories (10m)
- serving runtime and latency/cost controls (20m)
- hands-on demo: batching, KV-caching, and routing policies (20m)
- quick Q&A and next steps (10m)

Please pick two preferred slots from the list below so we can cluster attendees by timezone and availability. If none of the slots work, reply with your local availability windows and we will follow up.

Proposed slots (all durations 60m):
A) Thu Aug 31 | 10:00–11:00 PDT / 19:00–20:00 CEST
B) Fri Sep 1 | 13:00–14:00 PDT / 22:00–23:00 CEST (late EU / early APAC friendly)
C) Mon Sep 4 | 07:00–08:00 PDT / 16:00–17:00 CEST (APAC-friendly)

Bridge: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890
Agenda and attendee grid attached. Once we lock the slot we will send a calendar invite to confirmed participants.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com

---

Message 2
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 11:05:00 -0400
From: Sara Jones <sara.jones@acme.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, ops@stratoworks.com, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@bytefield.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Grouped: Inference Showcase — pick 2 preferred slots (multi-prospect)

Hi Rafael —

Thanks for organizing. I can do A (Aug 31 10am PDT) and C (Sep 4 07am PDT). Prefer A if we need to pick one.

Quick note: our infra lead will join for the demo; they'd like to see a bit more focus on RBAC and audit logs during Q&A.

—Sara
Sara Jones
Head of ML Ops, ACME Corp
sara.jones@acme.com

---

Message 3
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 08:22:00 +01:00
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@bytefield.io>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Sara Jones <sara.jones@acme.com>, ops@stratoworks.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Grouped: Inference Showcase — pick 2 preferred slots (multi-prospect)

Hey Rafael —

Thanks — B (Sep 1 13:00 PDT) and C (Sep 4 07:00 PDT) work best for us. If you end up running two clustered sessions (one NA/EMEA, one APAC) we'd prefer the APAC slot (C) so our APAC engineering lead can join.

Also: can you share the attendee list (company + role) so we can decide whether to send a short pre-demo checklist?

Cheers,
Liam
Platform Eng Lead, ByteField
liam.oconnor@bytefield.io

---

Message 4 (internal coordination)
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -0700
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: (none)
Subject: Re: Grouped: Inference Showcase — pick 2 preferred slots (multi-prospect)

Rafael / Marissa —

Quick constraints from ops: we can staff two clustered sessions if we lock them this week. Proposed plan:
- Run NA/EMEA focused session on Thu Aug 31 10:00 PDT (slot A) — covers Sara and much of EU overlap.
- Run APAC-focused session on Mon Sep 4 07:00 PDT (slot C) — covers ByteField APAC and late-night EU folks.

That gives customers decent overlap and doesn't stretch our on-call hosts. Marissa, can you draft the two calendar invites and create two separate Zoom events? Use the same agenda PDF, update subject lines with region tags.

Also attach the attendee grid (I updated timezone column). Rafael, I'll add a short RBAC + audit logs bullet to the Q&A so ACME's infra lead is covered.

Kimberly Park
Sales Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

---

Message 5
Date: Fri, 24 Aug 2028 14:05:00 -0700
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jones <sara.jones@acme.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@bytefield.io>, ops@stratoworks.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Subject: Confirmed: NA/EMEA (Aug 31) + APAC (Sep 4) grouped sessions — calendar invites sent

Hi everyone —

Thanks for the quick replies. Per Kimberly's suggestion we'll run two clustered sessions:
- NA/EMEA: Thu Aug 31 | 10:00–11:00 PDT (agenda attached) — Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890
- APAC: Mon Sep 4 | 07:00–08:00 PDT (agenda attached) — Zoom: separate link (calendar invite)

I've sent calendar invites to the addresses you replied from; please accept so we can finalize attendee counts. Attached: agenda PDF and the attendee availability grid (includes timezones and confirmed reps).

If ACME wants the RBAC deep-dive to be heavier, let me know and Kimberly will re-balance the demo time.

Looking forward — will follow up with pre-demo checklist and brief environment questionnaire (short form) 48 hours before each session.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: 2028-08-22-inference-showcase-agenda.pdf, attendee-availability-grid.csv
Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123
